caption: The drawing depicts a manual grain or coffee grinder mounted on a vertical wooden board. The grinder consists of a large, conical metal hopper at the top, which is colored in rusty brown tones, where the material to be ground is poured in. Below the hopper is the main grinding mechanism, which protrudes slightly from the wooden board. Attached horizontally to the grinder is a metal handle or crank, which extends to the right and is colored in a similar brownish hue. Near the bottom, there is a metal chute through which the ground material exits. The wooden board is vertically aligned and rendered in shades of brown, with visible grain patterns and several metallic fasteners depicted as small round rivets or screws. The background of the drawing is plain, with a beige or off-white tone, showing no other objects or textures. There is a handwritten signature near the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Coffee Mill
